# M008 — Validation properties only at geometry level, invisible to PDM-only readers

## Description

When an assembly is split using External References, the PDM/structure file holds part identity but not geometry. If GVPs were attached only to `shape_aspect`s of solids/faces, they live in the geometry file and are unreachable from the structure file.

## Reproducer recipe

Two-file external-reference setup: structure file with `product`, `product_definition`; geometry file with one `manifold_solid_brep`. Place GVP for volume only on the `shape_aspect` of the solid in the geometry file.

## Expected kernel behavior

writers must always also emit GVPs at part/product level.
